notes: Fees conflict: the programme's own page states €8,600/semester (the value used), while the DAAD page states 8,200 EUR per semester for applicants from all countries and adds 'Tuition fees may vary'. Both quotes are given as evidence. Tuition is stated per semester, not per year. Two application deadlines appear: the own page gives 'Application Deadline 30 June 2027', the FAQ gives 'The application portal is open from 1 September 2025 to 30 June 2026'; the 2027 cycle was used. Application channel: neither page mentions uni-assist or a VPD, so 'de-university-direct' is used on the strength of the programme's own online application portal; a Moroccan applicant with a foreign diploma is not told to change channel. No document-translation requirement was found on any page, so translationRequired is null everywhere. The scholarship page (bachelor) was not used for tuition because it is a reduction programme, not a fee.
